verdict.rationale: Productboard documents custom drivers and data fields such as value, risk, impact, confidence, and effort on features and initiatives, which can be updated to drive prioritization. Feedback notes are linked to features to quantify demand, and configuration endpoints expose these field definitions. missing for 10: direct scoring fields on feedback items themselves (the evidence only shows scoring on features/initiatives), first-party docs on the in-app scoring/prioritization UI (evidence mostly describes MCP/API updates), independent or hands-on corroboration.
